title: dep-illumination: generate shallow build profiles for selective CI
author: Alex Mercer
release_notes: Introduces a dependency-driven CI profile generator that reduces CI work by running only the linters/tests/build tasks impacted by a change. Falls back to full matrix for non-deterministic or infra changes.
description: Context: CI run times for small changes are often dominated by an undifferentiated lint/test matrix. This increases turnaround time and cost for engineers. Motivation: provide a safe, gradual optimization that runs only the minimal set of checks for a given change while retaining a full-matrix fallback for infra-critical edits. What this PR does: adds a lightweight tool (tools/dep-illumination) that computes a transitive dependency footprint for changed files and emits a shallow build profile consumed by the Actions workflows. The generator supports: 1) package-level graph traversal for the monorepo; 2) heuristics to map changed files to test suites and lint groups; 3) an opt-in override file (ci/force-full-matrix) and a conservative fallback when files touch build/infra or toolchain definitions; 4) cache-aware keys so repeated small edits don't re-run expensive prebuild steps. Implementation notes: - tools/dep-illumination implemented in Go, small binary with zero runtime deps, integrated into .github/composite/actions as an initial step - CI workloads read the generated profile to shape the matrix for linters, unit tests, and small integration shards - Added a minimal e2e smoke job (nightly) that validates parity with the full-matrix output on a rolling sample - Ship plan: feature gated behind `ci.enable_dep_illumination` repo secret and rollout to fast-feedback lane first Safety and correctness: conservative heuristics favor full-matrix for ambiguous changes; added unit tests for graph traversal, and integration smoke runs against a recorded commit set. Metrics: on a 200-PR sample the shallow profiles reduced aggregate runner minutes by ~43% and median feedback latency by ~38% (fast-feedback lane). Checklist: - [x] Tool implementation and unit tests - [x] GH Actions integration and composite action - [x] Documentation in docs/dev-guide/selective-ci.md - [x] Nightly smoke to validate parity - [x] Rollout gating and telemetry hooks Future work: extend heuristics for language-specific test discovery and support for per-team policy overrides.
